zh.headline: 把複雜的技術，轉化為看得見的商業成果
zh.subHeadline: 從架構評估、系統整合，到帶領團隊交付。

body.text: 我是具備跨國企業實戰經驗的 CTO 與技術顧問。過去十年，我不只規劃架構，也親自帶領團隊交付大型電商、企業系統整合與高併發媒體平台，協助企業把技術方案落實到營運現場。
我能協助的工作
技術評估與盡職調查
評估技術路線的風險與發展機會，並在方案評估或投資前提供第二意見及技術盡職調查。
系統架構與資料整合
整理分散的資料流，重整系統架構與整合方式，協助處理影響交付或營運的瓶頸。
團隊執行與交付
在需要時帶領團隊執行，讓確認的方案完成交付。
代表經歷
企業級電商：帶領 70 人研發團隊，為全球最大健康與美容零售商打造高併發 SAP 電商平台，並加入智慧化能力。
跨系統整合：為全球知名消費性電子品牌整合多通路客服、Salesforce、HubSpot、RingCentral 與 RMA 退換貨流程，改善營運效率。
媒體科技：主導高併發社群平台與生成式內容系統的架構優化，提升服務穩定性與擴展能力。
合作方式
正職｜兼職｜顧問
謝絕博弈、加密貨幣與交易所相關項目。

en.headline: Turning complex technology into visible business outcomes
en.subHeadline: From architecture reviews and system integration to team delivery.

body.text: I am a CTO and technical advisor with multinational enterprise experience. Over the past decade, I have planned architectures and led teams delivering enterprise e-commerce, system integration, and high-concurrency media platforms.
How I can help
Technical reviews and due diligence
Assess risks and opportunities, and provide an independent view before technical or investment decisions.
Architecture and data integration
Reorganize fragmented data flows, reshape system architecture, and address bottlenecks affecting delivery or operations.
Team execution and delivery
Lead hands-on execution when a team needs support carrying an agreed plan through delivery.
Representative experience
Enterprise e-commerce: led a 70-person engineering team to build a high-concurrency SAP e-commerce platform with intelligent capabilities for the world's largest health and beauty retailer.
System integration: connected multichannel customer support, Salesforce, HubSpot, RingCentral, and RMA workflows for a major global consumer electronics brand, improving operational efficiency.
Media technology: led architecture improvements for high-concurrency community platforms and generative content systems, improving service stability and scalability.
Engagement
Full-time | Part-time | Advisory
I do not take on gambling, cryptocurrency, or exchange-related projects.
